cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(godot_editor_shell LANGUAGES CXX)
if(DEFINED PACKAGE_FIND_FILE)
    include(${PACKAGE_FIND_FILE})
endif()
add_library(godot SHARED IMPORTED)
set_target_properties(godot PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../libs/${OHOS_ARCH}/libgodot.so")
add_library(entry SHARED napi_init.cpp runtime_paths.cpp)
target_compile_features(entry PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(entry PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(entry PRIVATE godot ace_napi.z native_window rawfile.z)
